name: Student Temporary Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: For university-level study, applicants present their apostilled certificate of studies and high-school diploma. For primary/secondary study, a parent or guardian must sign an Affidavit of Support Declaration before a local notary. Standard supporting documents: passport, apostilled birth certificate, apostilled police record, and apostilled marriage/divorce certificate if applicable. A tax fee of USD 210 applies. No specific statute or decree number was found citing this as a distinct legal category separate from Paraguay's general temporary-residency framework -- it may be a standard application of the general economic/enrollment-solvency test under Ley 6984/22 rather than its own named route, a distinction this build could not confirm either way.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrollment (with apostilled academic credentials) or, for minors, a notarized guardian support affidavit, then apply for temporary residency at DNM.

evidence_required.document: Apostilled birth certificate and police record
